title: VEL-STREET-CONCOURS-01 — What are you wearing today (Weekender · Meridian · Vivienne)
summary: v2 (2026-09-02 late): scripts rewritten into complete flowing sentences per Brooks, 30s per woman, runs to the COLLECTION page, no per-person price, offer announced once after the three women (Vivienne's close + a 3s end card). Same three women, same beats, same keyframes. Seedance 2.5 passes rendering; finals in final/.

timelines.label: REFERENCE CREATIVE
timelines.source: Instagram @classofpalmbeach reel DcRsKHHBW45 · 1:55 · Pebble Beach Concours lawn

beats.script: INTERVIEWER: What are you wearing today? / HER: Ralph Lauren. / INT: You look phenomenal.
beats.visual: Woman 1, tan suit and hat, full body on the lawn, bag in hand, cars and crowd behind
beats.emotion: Envy with permission. HOOK: stranger asks, one-word answer, format taught in four seconds.

beats.script: (no dialogue)
beats.visual: She turns away, camera drops to the bag from behind
beats.emotion: The bag gets the last look. PRODUCT BEAT.

beats.script: Today is a Ralph Lauren day. Just doing everything Ralph.
beats.visual: Woman 2 wide, striped blazer, black hat, black croc bag, vintage car behind
beats.emotion: Confidence, a little theatre. SETUP for the itemised list.

beats.script: Even down to the belt.
beats.visual: Tilt down to her hands on the belt buckle
beats.emotion: Detail as proof. DEMO: she points, the camera follows.

beats.script: A little Ralph, just a little Ricky. Something special for Pebble.
beats.visual: She lifts the bag by both handles, front square to the lens
beats.emotion: THE PRODUCT SHOT. Pride, not pitch.

beats.script: (no dialogue)
beats.visual: Bag hangs at her side, tilt to shoes
beats.emotion: Hold on the object. PRODUCT BEAT.

beats.script: INT: Your accessories. / HER: All the accessories, gifts for my darling husband.
beats.visual: Face, sunglasses, hat, ringed hand gesture
beats.emotion: Warmth, a story behind the objects. HUMAN BEAT.
beats.note: Interviewer praise is off-camera audio; ours is a card

beats.script: INT: You're incredible.
beats.visual: Macro: hand on the bag handle, stacked rings, bag body below
beats.emotion: Texture close. DEMO: jewelry shot that keeps the bag in frame.
beats.note: Mirror: rings WITH hand on our handle

beats.script: INT: And this necklace, come on. / HER: This was custom made.
beats.visual: Hand to the beaded collar, face close, smiling
beats.emotion: Flattered. CLOSE on a laugh.

beats.script: INT: What are you wearing today? / HER: A Carolina Herrera dress.
beats.visual: Woman 3 wide: saucer hat, polka-dot dress, white jacket, box bag, red car
beats.emotion: Reset. HOOK again: the pattern is a game.

beats.script: Gucci, the coat, and Dolce and Gabbana, and Chanel.
beats.visual: Tilt down: jacket buttons, box bag in hand, shoes
beats.emotion: The list. DEMO: every name gets its object within a second.

beats.script: INT: Show us the arm. / HER: Schiaparelli.
beats.visual: Gold cuff and rings on the raised wrist
beats.emotion: Interviewer directs the body. Ask-then-show rhythm.

beats.script: And Schiaparelli earrings. / INT: Amazing.
beats.visual: Bag and watch close in hand, up to face, profile for the earring
beats.emotion: Bag close then a smile. CLOSE.

beats.script: INT: Love your outfit. / HER: Yes. Love.
beats.visual: Woman 4, white outfit, panama, canvas-and-tan bag held up front-on, jacket over the arm
beats.emotion: Effortless. PRODUCT BEAT: bag lifted to camera again.
beats.note: Jacket over the arm = travel cue

beats.script: INT: And your shoes? / HER: Chanel. / INT: And the hat? / HER: No brand. / INT: The rings?
beats.visual: Shoes, then hand extended for rings
beats.emotion: 'No brand' gets a laugh. HUMAN BEAT.

beats.script: INT: What are you wearing today? / HER: Prada. / INT: Stunning. And the bag.
beats.visual: Woman 5, check shirt dress, quick
beats.emotion: Pace. Six seconds in and out.

beats.script: INT: How about the bag? / HER: Vintage Chanel. / INT: Stunning.
beats.visual: Woman 6 paisley, feather hat, cream quilted flap bag on a chain
beats.emotion: 'And the bag?' is the whole reel. PRODUCT BEAT.
beats.note: The bag question is a card for us

beats.script: INT: And the bag? / HER: Schiaparelli. / INT: And the watch? / HER: Cartier.
beats.visual: Woman 7 green scarf, cream bag lifted; wrist with tank watch
beats.emotion: Provenance stories. HUMAN BEAT.
beats.note: Wrist on the bag handle in ours

beats.script: INT: I can't miss the ring. / HER: David Webb. Thank you so much.
beats.visual: Face, laugh, cut to black
beats.emotion: Ends on gratitude, no CTA. Organic ending.

notes.title: v2 RULING (Brooks 9/02)
notes.text: Every spoken line is a complete, naturally flowing sentence with its object: 'It holds three days' worth of clothes and it still fits in the overhead bin', never 'Holds three days, slides in the overhead bin'. Calibrated on the @shoppingwith.vale yapper. Runs to the collection page; offer announced once at the end, not per person.

notes.title: APPROVE HERE
notes.text: Nine keyframes, three per woman: K1 start (the Seedance 2.5 first frame), K2 lift, K3 jewelry. Approve or reject per card. Rejects get a re-roll with the sibling variants already on disk (three per frame). Nothing animates until this board is approved.

notes.title: DO
notes.text: Mirror the reference beat for beat: mid shot, lift the bag to the lens, hold it still, tilt down the outfit, rings or watch on the bag handle, face, out. Overcast lawn, vintage cars, hats, crowd behind. Handheld phone, crooked framing, no music, no mic in shot. Product in frame in every beat. 'No brand' answer stays in.

notes.title: DON'T
notes.text: No spoken interviewer (cards only). No handbag brand named other than Velantra. No 'Birkin' in any generation prompt. No shoulder carry on the Weekender or Vivienne. Never open, unfasten or press the Weekender on camera. No 'structured' for the Vivienne. No em dashes, no 'our', no 'we'. Never name the real event.

notes.title: ENGINE NEXT
notes.text: Seedance 2.5 (kie bytedance/seedance-2-5 or Higgsfield), first_frame = the approved K1, duration 26 matching the FORMAT line and beat windows, generate_audio true, creator voice cloned in ElevenLabs as the audio reference so 'Velantra' is pronounced right. Weekender lift beat is the hardware-mutation risk: fallback is K2 hard-cut into the take. Cards, captions and segment cuts in post.

notes.title: FLAGS
notes.text: Meridian: all six colorways were oversold ~1,760 units on 8/21; no spend on W2 until stock or a pre-order PDP with a ship date. Vivienne is pre-order, ships October, stated in beat 6. Prices verified live 9/02: Weekender $159.99 (cmp $209.99), Meridian $124.99 (cmp $149.99), Vivienne $149.99 (cmp $199.99).
